verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly state Jev is not trained on customer requests/responses and not fine-tuned or LoRA-adapted with customer data, with zero data retention (ZDR) available for enterprise customers and pointers to a DPA/Privacy Policy. This directly satisfies the privacy-posture story as a default guarantee rather than a user-toggle. Missing for 10: independent/community verification of the no-training claim, and clarity on whether ZDR (not just no-training) applies to non-enterprise customers.
